instruction: Follow all the classical artists on Spotify that have at least 22 followers.
notes: Single-app task (spotify) plus supervisor lookups. The number of matching classical artists is unknown a priori, so three placeholder artist constants stand for the search result set; at runtime one spotify.follow_artist call is issued per artist returned by search_artists (query='classical', genre='classical', min_follower_count=22, paging over page_index until empty), filtered to genre == classical. The artists are declared as domain constants so that supervisor-complete-task's precondition can enumerate every goal condition, as required. search_artists needs no access token; follow_artist carries extra non-API parameters (genre, follower-count) only to link each follow to the completed search via the static artist-matches facts. The username is read from supervisor.show_profile (email), hence profile-known is a login precondition. No answer is passed to complete_task since the task is not a question. Evaluation requires only additions to UserArtistFollowing, all of genre classical with follower_count >= 22, which the goal mirrors via (following ...).
